result.summary: Admission for hepatic and peritoneal abscesses, acute pancreatitis, biliary obstruction, and ileus with malnutrition/failure to thrive. Bed planning should account for documented abdominal drainage, biliary/pancreatic stents, and enteral/parenteral nutritional support; continued device and infusion needs require confirmation. No invasive respiratory support or contact-isolation indication is documented.
result.contact_isolation_reason: Peritoneal cultures grew mixed flora, Bacteroides fragilis group, and Clostridium perfringens, without a documented contact-precaution indication. MRSA and VRE screens were negative.
tubes: Percutaneous abdominal drain (procedure March 12; continued presence unconfirmed)
Enteral feeding access (type unspecified; enteral infusion documented March 4)
